scope: exploratory single-task smoke; not a full tau-voice score

runtime.caller_speech: fishaudio/s2-pro on the same local endpoint
runtime.pricing_note: Compatibility label used by the upstream pricing ledger; cost is a tau proxy, not actual composite-provider spend.

official_provider_suite.execution_condition: Unmodified official tests and adapter; benchmark client pinned to CPU 30 with Linux FIFO priority 10 because the shared host had 0% CPU idle.

saturated_host_tail_evidence.dominant_unrelated_process: xmrig at approximately 2171% CPU, plus multiple Android emulators
saturated_host_tail_evidence.interpretation: The failures were official wall-clock tail failures and remain negative evidence. The scheduling-isolated full rerun establishes protocol/function conformance, not uncontended deployment latency.

paired_task.selection: chosen before the paired rerun because it requires two factual tool reads and exact numeric communication

baseline.speech_transport: provider-fragment forwarding without realtime audio-ahead pacing

optimized.fast_policy: one self-contained spoken micro-turn of at most twelve words

limitations: One task and one sequential run per condition do not estimate a distribution or prove general superiority.
Hosted model and local speech sampling can vary even with the same benchmark seed.
The final 12-case conformance pass required benchmark-client scheduling isolation on a CPU-saturated shared host; ordinary scheduling produced one over-budget client tick in each of two reruns.
The full 278-task control and regular cells, native baselines, cadence sweeps, and disclosed regular-condition Fish voices remain to be run.
Raw upstream simulations remain in the ignored runtime checkout; this checked record contains only secret-free aggregate evidence.
